Definition: Laish, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Laish = "lion"; n pr m; 1) father of Phaltiel, the man to whom king Saul gave his daughter Michal in marriage even though she was already married to David; n pr loc; 2) an early name for Dan, a town in northern Israel; 3) a place north of Jerusalem; site unknown
